summary: Mac's Momentum law-firm builder now performs a bounded public website audit, supports a browser-local local-pack screenshot, renders Audit and Ranker modes, and exports a verified one-page letter PDF.
verification: Browser JavaScript and Netlify function syntax checks pass.
The audit function returns 11 evidence-backed checks for a public website and rejects a private loopback target with HTTP 400.
The isolated Netlify draft returns HTTP 200 and its deployed audit function completed successfully.
Audit and Ranker modes, uploaded screenshot visibility, four prioritized finding cards, and mobile layout passed browser automation with no console or page errors.
The 390 px mobile view has no horizontal overflow and shows the complete scaled document preview.
The exported PDF was rendered and visually inspected as a single US Letter page.
Ranking language is illustrative and states that no placement is guaranteed.
The existing production Netlify URL was not replaced.
assumptions: The previously supplied Momentum brand and expert identity assets remain approved for this one-pager.
risks: The draft audits the submitted public homepage only and does not read or modify a Google Business Profile.
Replacing the existing production site remains a separate approval-gated action.
